symbols.name: ALLOWED_TAGS
doc: These are the only tags the rich-text editor can produce (bold, italic, underline, text in one of the palette's five colours via <span style="color">, paragraphs/line breaks). I strip anything outside this set on save so a crafted payload can never inject script/style/img or event handlers into a stored announcement. I use sanitize-html because it is pure Node (no jsdom / no ESM chain), so it bundles cleanly into the Vercel serverless runtime, unlike isomorphic-dompurify, whose jsdom dependency triggers ERR_REQUIRE_ESM there. "a" is allowed ONLY as the marker of a PDF link (see below): it never keeps an address.

symbols.name: sanitizeAnnouncementHtml
symbols.sig: export function sanitizeAnnouncementHtml( html: string | null | undefined,): string
doc: I sanitize editor HTML for safe storage and rendering. Any tag or attribute outside the rich-text whitelist is removed. `style` is permitted only for a text `color` (the editor's one styling feature); I drop every other style property and all URI-bearing attributes. Returns a trimmed string; an effectively-empty document collapses to "".

symbols.name: htmlToPlainText
symbols.sig: export function htmlToPlainText(html: string | null | undefined): string
doc: I derive a plain-text projection of the (already sanitized) HTML for embedding and literal search. Block/line boundaries become spaces so words don't run together; entities are decoded; whitespace is collapsed.

behaviours: the palette is the toolbar's five colours: red, blue, green, amber, purple
each colour has two patterns: as #rrggbb (any case) and as rgb(r, g, b), which is how a browser gives it back
${c.name} (${c.value}) is kept, as the editor writes it
a palette colour in capitals, or as rgb() (the form a browser gives back when a saved announcement is opened for editing), is kept
the pale grey that pasted text carries is dropped, and the words stay
any other colour goes: a keyword, a short hex, another hex, another rgb
every other style property goes (background, size, font, position), even beside a palette colour, which stays
bold, italic, underline, strike, paragraphs and line breaks are kept
headings, lists, links, images and scripts are not kept (their words are, where they have any)
saving twice changes nothing, and an empty document collapses to nothing
blank paragraphs between paragraphs (a blank line typed for readability) are kept as they are and add nothing to the plain text that is searched
a PDF link is kept, exactly as the editor writes it (marker, role, tabindex, title) and nothing else
whatever else a PDF link carries is dropped, an address above all (it can never point anywhere)
an ordinary link (pasted from a page) becomes plain words: no <a>, no address, the words stay
a link with a javascript: address is flattened the same way
a PDF link beside a palette colour keeps both, and saving twice changes nothing
the words of a PDF link are in the plain text that is searched, the markup is not
pasted colour is removed from the style of every element, the words and the other markup stay
background-color is not mistaken for color, and single-quoted style attributes are handled
HTML with no style is returned untouched, and so is an empty or missing input
a style that held only a colour is removed altogether
the editor takes its swatches from the palette (Default first), and strips the colour of pasted text
the saving code allows only the palette's colours
